Northland upgraded $ALAB to Outperform with a $350 price target. Analyst Gus Richard: “We expect earnings revisions to become more positive and the AI infrastructure spending cycle to last longer than anticipated.” Content per rack will continue to increase, while ALAB is expected to gain share in scale-up/scale-out switching and signal conditioning. New major funding commitments ($200B Anthropic + $500B Nvidia partnerships) could push the peak of spending out to 2027. ALAB is expected to remain one of the fastest-growing companies in AI infrastructure chips. #ALAB

$UBER is scaling up drone delivery by investing in Zipline. The goal: 1 million drone deliveries per day by the end of 2029. The CEO expects drones to become a meaningful growth driver for Uber Eats by enabling faster deliveries over longer distances. Another step forward in autonomous logistics.

$RKLB has taken another step forward on the national security front. Viasat selected Rocket Lab’s Lightning-GEO platform for the U.S. Space Force’s anti-jam (PTS-G) satellite. Peter Beck: “This award reflects our growing role in national security space. We’re moving from the design phase into production.” The fact that the same Lightning bus is being reused across different programs, along with the strengthening Space Systems backlog, is particularly noteworthy.

$NOW • AI ACV has surpassed $1 billion, while agentic AI has grown 9x. • 20%+ revenue growth and a 98–99% renewal rate point to strong and highly predictable revenue. • The CEO made a personal stock purchase, while Jensen Huang describes the company as an “enterprise AI OS.” • Forward valuation is currently at historically attractive levels. And now, the technical setup is adding to the story: the stock appears to be on the verge of a major breakout. Strong fundamentals, an attractive valuation, and a technical setup that looks ready.

Deutsche Bank $ASTS Model Summary (2030E): 320 cumulative commercial satellites 65.4 million supplemental coverage subscribers ~180 million Day Pass users 25 million primary broadband subscribers Total revenue: $4.47 billion Adj. EBITDA: $3.60 billion (80%+ margin) FCF: $864 million The key takeaway: The bottleneck isn’t demand or production — it’s launch capacity. With 60+ MNO partners and a potential subscriber base of 3 billion, the model assumes only a 2% conversion rate. Even that looks like a conservative scenario. #ASTS

I’ve been watching $UBER closely for months, and after the last quarter I think the market is misreading this one badly. Start with the number everyone reacted to. Revenue grew 12%. That’s the headline, and the headline is why the stock sold off. But look underneath it. Gross bookings climbed 22% to over $58 billion, the fourth straight quarter above 20%. Trips were up 18% to 3.87 billion and monthly active users hit 208 million, up 16%. So why the gap? Business model changes knocked eight percentage points off reported revenue growth. The UK change alone cut the mobility take rate by 400 basis points, which is an accounting effect and nothing more. Volume is accelerating while the reported top line looks soft. Anyone screening on revenue growth misses that entirely. The real story is cash. Uber closed 2025 with $8.7 billion in adjusted EBITDA and $9.8 billion in free cash flow, up 42% year over year. Last quarter they crossed a threshold: $2.9 billion in operating cash flow and $2.8 billion in free cash flow, and trailing twelve-month FCF passed $10 billion for the first time in company history. This was a business burning billions in 2017. Margins are moving too. Non-GAAP operating income reached 3.7% of gross bookings versus 3.3% a year ago, with non-GAAP EPS up 35% to $0.81. Bookings up 22%, earnings up 35%. That’s operating leverage doing what it’s supposed to do. I’d ignore the GAAP figure, since it includes a $1.6 billion gain from revaluing equity investments and won’t repeat. Delivery Hero hasn’t gotten enough attention. Uber agreed to pay €41.50 per share in cash, valuing it at $14.8 billion, or $13.7 billion net of the stake already owned, taking the platform to 99 markets. Markets where Uber offers both mobility and delivery go from 34 to 58. Here’s why that matters: customers who use both products generate roughly three times the gross bookings and profit of single-product users. Management is targeting over $1.2 billion in run-rate synergies. It closes in the second half of 2027. You pay now and collect later, which the market hates and I don’t mind. On autonomy, the data so far supports the bull case. In Austin and Atlanta, where Waymo runs on Uber’s platform, trips per vehicle per day are up 30% and wait times down 25%, and both cities are among Uber’s fastest-growing US markets. Autonomous supply is expanding the market, not eating it. They’re targeting 15 AV cities by year end. That said, Uber and Waymo ended their Phoenix partnership in May and those cars went back to Waymo’s own app. Uber calls Phoenix a deliberately small pilot and points to hundreds of Waymo vehicles still exclusive to its app in Austin and Atlanta. Fair enough, but the two are set to compete head-on in London. The “everyone needs us” argument is weaker than it was. The “we own the demand” argument still holds. Buybacks keep working in the background. 46.6 million shares retired for $3.53 billion in the first half, with $15.7 billion left on the authorization. Share count fell 4% year over year even with Q2 repurchases cut to $510 million because capital went into the Delivery Hero stake. Where it trades: around $75, against an average target of $106.71 across 61 analysts. The stock is down 18% over the past year and sitting near its 52-week low. The market is pricing this on today’s earnings and assigning the AV business roughly nothing. Risks I take seriously. Total debt is up to $12.7 billion, cash down to $4.87 billion, with a €14.2 billion bridge facility for the deal. And the bigger one isn’t robotaxis: European driver classification is still unresolved, and reclassification in major markets would materially change the cost structure. Freight is still losing money. I’m long ,but I’m waiting for stronger technical signals and a better entry point before adding to my position.

$INTC After the April–July advance from the low 70s to 142, the stock entered a sustained correction. It bottomed in the 86–88 area in August and has since recovered, forming what looks like an inverse head and shoulders. The neckline sits at 104.80–106.35. Today it tagged that zone and reversed, closing at 102.50 (-1.97%). The pattern is not confirmed yet. A daily close above 104.80 puts 111.53 and 115.43 in play. A break below 98.21 invalidates the setup and reopens the August lows.

Cuma kapanışında spx yaklaşık 7800 iken dealer’ların net gamma’sı yaklaşık +4bn’a yükselmiş yani Cuma günü piyasa long gamma durumunda ve bu genellikle dealer’ların hareketleri absorbe ederek volatiliteyi bastırmasına yardımcı olur. Ama bu long gamma’nın %72’si bugün expire olacak, dolayısıyla çok kısa ömürlü. 7800’ün altında dealer pozisyonu short gamma’ya, üstünde ise long gamma’ya yakın davranabilir. Short gamma ortamında piyasa yükselirken dealer’lar daha fazla almak, düşerken daha fazla satmak zorunda kalabileceğinden hareketler hızlanıp ve volatilite artabilir. Ayrıca dealer vega yaklaşık 200m ile son iki yılın en düşük seviyelerinde..

Haftalık portföy update Değişmeyenler: irwd wve evmn Kapananlar: abcl spcx Azalanlar: sgmt nktr Artanlar : Yeni eklenenler: ntla Mutluluk nedir bilmezler Hep ağlarlar hiç gülmezler Nedense hiç sevilmezler Boynu bükükler Küçük Emrah’ın 1986 yılında shortçuları tanımlamak için yazdığı yukarıdaki dizeleri akademik olarak ele alıp short sellerların neden sevilmediğini çözmeye çalışalım 2013’te Journal of Economic Psychology’de yayımlanan “Not all financial speculation is treated equally: Laypeople’s moral judgments about speculative short selling” çalışması 4 deneyde toplam 569 kişiyi incelemiş Sonuçlara baktığımızda Aynı yatırımcı aynı finansal motivasyon hatta aynı kar elde etse bile short pozisyon alan yatırımcı, long pozisyon alan yatırımcıdan daha ahlaksız olarak değerlendiriliyor. Üstelik bunu farklı koşullarda tekrar tekrar test ediyorlar: Short başarılı olsa da, short başarısız olsa da, shortlanan varlığın iyi/kötü karakteri değiştirilse de yatırım vadesi değiştirilse de insanların shortçulara yönelik negatif ahlaki yargısı devam ediyor. Shortçular neden sevilmiyor ?lol temel bir psikolojik asimetri var aslında İnsanların zihnindeki basit model şu Long: Şirket başarılı olsun ben kazanayım Short: Şirket başarısız olsun ben kazanayım. İkinci durum insanların zihninde zarardan faydalanmak şeklinde kodlanıyor. İnsanlar kaybı kazançtan daha güçlü hissediyor. Dolayısıyla bir şirketin düşüşünden para kazanan kişi, long olanların yaşadığı zararla psikolojik olarak ilişkilendiriliyor Bir de İnsanlar davranışın kalitesini süreçten ziyade sonucuna göre değerlendirebiliyor. Adam şirketin düşmesini istedi ve insanlar zarar etti e ozaman bu kötü adam. Long pozisyonda kazanç ekonomik büyümenin sonucu gibi algılanabiliyor. Short’ta ise kazanç doğrudan başkasının kaybından geliyor gibi görülüyor o da başka bir etken Ama finansal açıdan bu ikisi simetrik: Birinin overpriced olduğunu düşünüyorsan, bunu ifade etmek de piyasaya bilgi sağlamaktır. Faydası zararının 189 katıdır(attım sayıyı) Şimdi asıl tuhaf olan insanlara bunu anlatmanın bir işe yaramadığı gerçeği :) 2020’de Journal of Business Research’te yayımlanan başka bir çalışma bunu özellikle test etmiş: “To short or not to short? Improving morality judgments of short trades and short traderse bakınız Araştırmacılar insanlara short selling’in price discovery ve market efficiency sağladığını anlatıyorlar. Bu ekonomik argüman short selling’e yönelik algıyı iyileştiriyor. Ama Sadece ekonomik faydayı anlatmak, short seller’ı long seller kadar ahlaki hale getirmeye yetmiyor. İnsanlar bildiğin ikna olmuyor :)) problem sadece insanların short selling’in faydasını bilmemesi değil. İnsanların short selling’e yönelik sezgisel moral bir antipatisi var. Ve bu çok güçlü. Hiç bir zaman değişeceğini de zannetmiyorum. O yüzden bu topa hiç girmemek gerek sanırım. Ne kadar anlatırsam anlatayım shortçulardan nefret etmeye devam edicez (çoğu zaman haksız olarak) :) İrwd de armistice in poz azaltması hoşuma gitmedi Sgmt de Çin’den gelicek haber öncesi 10 doları gördük. Geri çeklilmekerde eklemek üzere biraz kar aldım Nktr katalizörsüzlük etkili olmaya devam ediyor biraz zaman stopu uyguladım Ntla çok kalabalık bir kağıt.
